comment: Deterministic-admission toolchain floor. run-skill-admission probes every entry before the first gate runs; a miss fails TOOLCHAIN_PRECONDITION_FAILED at preflight instead of a mid-suite environment failure. This file is part of the admission source fingerprint (collectAdmissionInputFiles includes scripts/admission), so editing it invalidates resume and prior evidence.

tools.hint: CI pins Node 22 via actions/setup-node; local dev must match
runs the git diff --check gate and backs the dirty-tree guard

doc-code-verify Java fragment gate (verify-feishu-doc-code.js degrades to manual without it and verifier tests fail). CI installs Temurin 17 via actions/setup-java; local macOS: brew install --cask temurin@17
doc-code-verify C++ self-test accepts clang++ or g++ (tests/skills/doc-code-verify-cpp.test.js)
